concept: Finding a sustainable way to serve others amid full-time work and family responsibilities
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult wants to contribute to a cause but has genuinely limited time and energy
exercise.reflection_prompt: What's a realistic form of service given your actual constraints, rather than an idealized one?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one sustainable, realistic form of ongoing contribution

assessment.success_marker: adult's proposal is genuinely sustainable given their real constraints, not an aspirational overcommitment
